svg.title: Burst fusion inference flow
svg.text: Inference: K frames in, one image out, in the first frame's coordinates
The same network at every K. K = 1 is the single-frame estimator; K = 16 replaces the 16-frame average an instrument would take.
What the reader should check in the images: the stain of the clean reference is absent from the single-frame output (K = 1) and smeared in the drifting
average; the fused image shows it at the clean contrast with the edges of a denoised image. Every number in the report is read on exactly these outputs.
Cost: registration ~ 50 ms per frame (GPU), K aligned resamplings, one tiled forward pass -- a few hundred milliseconds per 512x512 burst.
